title: Schr\"odinger--F\"ollmer Actor--Critic: Diffusion Policy Improvement with Finite-Sample Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2609.33239v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Diffusion policies represent multimodal action distributions, but a $Q$-weighted update does not specify how to sample from the resulting target distribution. We propose Schr\"odinger--F\"ollmer Actor--Critic (SFAC), an offline-to-online reinforcement learning (RL) method for Kullback--Leibler (KL)-regularized policy improvement through conditional diffusion. A minimax Bellman critic estimates the action-value function, which defines an exponentially tilted target policy. A Doob $h$-transform expresses this update as a correction to the reference diffusion drift. The target drift is a weighted conditional mean of Brownian-bridge labels. We fit it by weighted regression using endpoints from the current policy and pointwise action-value evaluations. In the small-update regime, the KL-regularized update follows the natural policy-gradient direction, and the Doob correction represents the same local change in the space of diffusion

translated_title: 薛定谔–弗尔默 Actor–Critic：具有有限样本分析的扩散策略改进
translated_abstract: 扩散策略能够表示多模态的动作分布，但基于Q值加权的更新并未说明如何从所得的目标分布中进行采样。我们提出了薛定谔–弗尔默 Actor–Critic（SFAC），这是一种离线到在线的强化学习方法，通过条件扩散实现带KL（Kullback–Leibler）正则化的策略改进。极小极大贝尔曼评论家估计动作价值函数，该函数定义了一个指数倾斜的目标策略。Doob h-变换将该更新表示为对参考扩散漂移的修正。目标漂移是布朗桥标签的加权条件均值。我们通过加权回归对其进行拟合，使用来自当前策略的端点以及逐点的动作价值评估。在小更新情形下，KL正则化更新遵循自然策略梯度方向，而Doob修正表示扩散空间中相同的局部变化。
tldr: 该论文提出SFAC方法，利用极小极大贝尔曼评论家、Doob h-变换以及基于布朗桥端点的加权回归，在条件扩散框架中实现KL正则化的策略改进，并给出有限样本理论分析。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Schrödinger–Föllmer Actor–Critic (SFAC), which achieves KL-regularized policy improvement in conditional diffusion via a minimax Bellman critic, Doob h-transform corrections, and weighted Brownian-bridge regression, with finite-sample theoretical guarantees.
